settings.name: Bluesky-PDS-<RANDOM_SUFFIX>
settings.cmd: sh -c 'set -euo pipefail && apk add --no-cache openssl curl bash jq coreutils gnupg util-linux-misc >/dev/null && curl -o /usr/local/bin/pdsadmin.sh https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bluesky-social/pds/main/pdsadmin.sh && chmod 700 /usr/local/bin/pdsadmin.sh && ln -sf /usr/local/bin/pdsadmin.sh /usr/local/bin/pdsadmin && touch $PDS_DATA_DIRECTORY/pds.env && exec node --enable-source-maps index.js'
